explanation: Place one queen per row and try each column, checking it against all earlier queens for column or diagonal conflicts. Copy the column placement when all rows are valid.
timeComplexity: O(n²·n!) conservative search bound including placement checks
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary recursion/placement, plus O(n·n!) worst-case output bound
